actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, multiplicity-adjusted RNA identity evidence (30/50 HALLMARK pathways, large effects) with a directionally consistent BAP1-enriched/PBRM1-depleted mutation pattern. Cross-modal membership is supported by a median of 3 of 4 positive per-modality silhouettes, an estimable fused probe with moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.66), and a positive boundary to C0002 across modalities. Confounder testing shows no significant technical or site association, and the partition shows minimal stage/grade overlap. Residual limitations (small silhouette magnitudes, WXS dispersion heterogeneity, nonsignificant WXS enrichment) are noted but do not undermine retention for downstream validation.

C0002 has coherent, multiplicity-adjusted RNA identity evidence reciprocal to C0001 (30/50 HALLMARK pathways, large effects) with a directionally consistent PBRM1-enriched/BAP1-depleted mutation pattern. Cross-modal membership is supported by a median of 3 of 4 positive per-modality silhouettes (CT negative but not contradictory), an estimable fused probe with moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.61), and a positive boundary to C0001. Confounder testing shows no significant technical or site association, and the partition shows minimal stage/grade overlap. Residual limitations (negative CT silhouette, small effect sizes, WXS dispersion heterogeneity) are noted but do not undermine retention for downstream validation.
